CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
DECEMBER 14, 2022

  Meeting ID: 886 5338 3950

  When you would like to comment during the meeting enter *9 on the phone's key pad to

Please note, the City is not responsible for the public's use of Zoom as it relates to the software,
configuration, and setting on a personal device. The public is encouraged to visit the Zoom
website for information on use of this software.

CALL TO ORDER / PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE / ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS / WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS

ORAL COMMUNICATION
Members of the public may address the City Council at this time. No action will be taken on non­
agenda items at this meeting. Speakers should limit comments to two (2) minutes each.

PRESENTATION- Barry Bergman ofW-Trans and Brian Hannegan of RRM Design will deliver
a presentation on the Mode Shift Feasibility Study, summarizing the input collected from
stakeholders and the public to date as well as the preliminary recommendations.

GENERAL BUSINESS

1.  Vehicle Discussion
  Discuss vehicle issues and Avalon Municipal Code Title 4: Public Safety, Article 17
  regarding vehicles.
  Recommended Action
  Provide direction to City Staff.

ADJOURN

NOTICE OF POSTING
I, Devin Elise Hart, declare that the Special City Council Agenda for Wednesday, December
14, 2022 was posted on Monday, December 12, 2022 on the City's website
www.cityofavalon.com, and at City Hall, 410 Avalon Canyon Road.

Devin Elise Hart, Management Analyst
